# Carevia written-paper image edits

Generated through Magnific using GPT Image 2.6 (`gpt-2-6`), 2k, high quality, one image per edit. Cost: 175 credits each; 350 total. Sources: existing premium-blue card photographs. Originals retained; new filenames avoid cached blank versions.

## certificates-assessments

Output: `certificates-assessments-written.png` plus responsive 480, 960 and 1600 pixel JPEGs.

```text
Keep the supplied photograph as it is: the same navy clipboard, ivory paper, metal clip, pen on the right, stethoscope bottom left, glass paperweight, flowers, blue clinical desk, camera angle, framing, object positions, light and realistic textures. Only add printing to the currently blank sheet of paper. This is an illustrative Portuguese medical certificate prop for a healthcare website, never a real issued certificate. Place an elegant dark navy printed heading "ATESTADO MÉDICO" across the upper-middle of the paper, comfortably below the clip, with a small subtitle "Exemplo ilustrativo". Below add well-spaced form typography: "Nome: Exemplo de utente", "Avaliação clínica", "Documento sujeito a avaliação médica." Add a few short ruled form fields and a thin navy divider. At the lower middle add "SEM VALIDADE CLÍNICA" clearly. All printing must obey the paper's perspective and look physically printed on it, not floating overlay text. Keep title and most writing within the central 35–70 percent of the image height so they survive a wide website crop. No real patient data, no completed diagnosis or fitness assertion, no doctor names, signatures, registration numbers, official stamps, government symbols, QR codes, logos or branding. Do not change the desk, color palette, lighting, composition or any other object.
```

## weight-management

Output: `weight-management-handwritten.png` plus responsive 480, 960 and 1600 pixel JPEGs.

```text
Keep this photograph exactly as it is: same ceramic fruit bowl with pear and oranges, blue measuring tape, cup, vase with white flowers, blue marble surface, open ivory notebook, window light, object positions, camera angle, composition, framing and blue colors. The only change is to add natural readable blue ballpoint-pen handwriting to BOTH blank notebook pages. The writing follows each page's exact perspective and paper curvature, with fine ink texture, slight human irregularity and generous spacing. It must look genuinely written by hand, not printed or a digital overlay. On the left page write the title "Hábitos saudáveis" and below three short lines: "Beber água", "Comer com variedade", "Incluir fruta e legumes". On the right page write the title "Cuidar de mim" and below three short lines: "Mexer o corpo", "Dormir bem", "Fazer pequenas pausas". Add two tiny blue pen check marks next to entries. Make handwriting large enough to remain noticeable in a small website card. Preserve Portuguese accents. No other text anywhere and no other changes. No diet promises, calorie targets, prescriptions, logos or watermarks.
```
